kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تفاهمت (form VI)
# تَفَاهَمْتُ (tafāhamtu) /ta.faː.ham.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# تَفَاهَمْتَ (tafāhamta) /ta.faː.ham.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# تَفَاهَمْتِ (tafāhamti) /ta.faː.ham.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَفَاهَمَ (tafāhama)
# تَفَاهَمَتْ (tafāhamat) /ta.faː.ha.mat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
